home.title: Share the yakka
home.pitch: One link for the whole household. Stick a QR code or NFC tag where the job happens and tap it when it's done. No sign-ups, no passwords.
home.emptyTitle: No groups on this device yet
home.emptyBody: Create a group, or open a group link someone shared with you. It'll show up here.

features.tapBody: QR codes and NFC tags complete a chore in one tap.
features.fairBody: Round-robin rotation and tallies keep it even.
features.privateBody: The group link is the key. Share it with your household.

create.title: Create a group
create.subtitle: A group is your household. You can change all of this later.
create.name: Group name
create.timezoneHint: Chores are due in this timezone.
create.membersHint: Just names. Everyone picks who they are when they open the link.
create.choresHint: Optional. Tap to add some common ones.

identity.title: Who are you?
identity.description: Pick your name so your chores are credited to you. This is remembered on this device only.
identity.noMembers: No one's here yet. Add yourself.
identity.transferUnknown: That link points to a member who isn't in this group.

chores.title: Chores
chores.emptyBody: Add the jobs that keep the household running.
chores.overdueBy: Overdue by {value}{unit, select, minute {m} hour {h} day {d} other {w}}
chores.statsEmpty: Nothing ticked off this week yet.

editor.title: What needs doing?
editor.descriptionPlaceholder: Optional details, e.g. recycling goes out on odd weeks
editor.rruleHint: iCalendar rule without DTSTART, e.g. FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,TH
editor.startsHint: The time of day it's due. Times are in {timezone}.
editor.dueHint: Leave empty for a chore that can be done any time. Times are in {timezone}.

anchors.DUE_DATEHint: Stays on its days even if done late (bins, bills).
anchors.COMPLETIONHint: Every N days after the last time (watering, haircuts).
anchors.ADAPTIVEHint: Learns the rhythm from past completions and flags it overdue once it's later than 4 in 5 past gaps. Uses the schedule above as a first guess.

editor.adaptiveLearning: Learning: {gaps, plural, one {# gap} other {# gaps}} between completions so far, needs {needed}.
editor.adaptiveLearned: Usually every {due}, overdue after {overdue} (from the last {gaps} gaps).
editor.archiveConfirmBody: It disappears from the list and its tags stop working. History is kept and you can restore it any time.

members.title: Members
members.archiveHint: Archived members leave rotations but keep their history.

settings.title: Settings
settings.notificationsHint: Reminders when chores are due or overdue, for whoever you are on this device. On iPhone and iPad, add Yakka to your Home Screen first: iOS only sends notifications to the installed app (iOS 16.4+).
settings.name: Name
settings.joinFromTag: New people can join from a tag
settings.joinFromTagHint: When off, someone scanning a tag must open the group link first.
settings.lockedHint: Enter the settings PIN to make changes.
settings.pinHint: Optional. Protects these settings on shared devices. Anyone with the link can still tick off chores.
settings.shareHint: Anyone with this link can see and change the group. Share it only with your household.
settings.transferHint: Scan this on your other phone. It opens the group as {name}.
settings.transferNoIdentity: Pick who you are first, then you can move to another device.
settings.localDataHint: Your groups and identities are stored only in this browser. Export them as a backup or to move everything at once.
settings.importInvalid: That doesn't look like Yakka export data.
settings.deleteHint: Deletes the group for everyone. It's kept for a short while before being purged.
settings.deleteConfirmBody: Everyone loses access to this group, its chores and its history. This can't be undone from the app.

notFound.title: Group not found
notFound.body: This group doesn't exist or has been deleted. Check the link, or ask whoever shared it for a new one.

errors.PIN_LOCKED: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in {wait}.
errors.GROUP_DELETION_DISABLED: Deleting groups is turned off on this server.
errors.MEMBER_ARCHIVED: That member is archived. Pick someone else.
errors.MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: That member no longer exists. Pick someone else.
